title: What If You Pulled 9 G Like a Fighter Pilot?

scenes.text: What if you pulled 9 G like a fighter pilot? Your blood becomes the problem.
At 9 G you weigh nine times more. An 80 kilogram person would feel like about 720.
Blood is dragged down toward your legs, and your vision narrows, like looking through a straw.
Untrained people black out around four and a half to six G, losing sight, then consciousness.
Without the straining technique, you'd have only seconds. Then you'd be out for around 10 to 30 seconds.
Pilots survive with an inflating suit and a trained forced breath every few seconds. Your body alone can't.

description:
What if you pulled 9 G like a fighter pilot?
Your blood would drain from your head, your vision would collapse, and you'd likely pass out in seconds.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Would you ride a jet that pulls 9 G? Drop a what-if for us to run through next.
